event.description: Factor only the shared feed-forward output transform at rank 7
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 16 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0022, which retained projection-free feed-forward width 10 at 3,040 parameters and 99.85%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0105, whose rank-7 input-transform factorization validly scored 0.01% at 1,660 parameters. Hypothesis: feature construction is full-rank-sensitive, but residual reconstruction may tolerate a rank-7 output transform. This complementary representational change keeps the current 236-group input map and GELU width 16 exact, replacing only the 227-group output map with its best rank-7 SVD factors (7x16 and 16x7), yielding 1,669 parameters. It is more informative than rank 6 because rank 7 is the highest and least lossy factorization that is strictly smaller than the current output map, and it cleanly localizes rank sensitivity to the output side. Attention, normalization, token/position representations, and generic autoregressive decoding remain unchanged.
